summary: First full test pass on Cosmic Clarity. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass covering auth/login, /auth/me, terminology (simple/traditional/both), config, geo search, chart/today/dasha/transits/panchang/numerology, tarot draw, compatibility (Guna Milan, score 0-36), vastu analyze (score+findings), conversations & message (AI reply OK), entitlement read, and signup smoke. Frontend: Auth screen, Today dashboard (hero/insight/tarot/panchang/period/timing/quick links), Chart (North Indian diagram + planets + nakshatra), Dasha timeline, Numerology, Compatibility form, Tarot, Vastu grid, Paywall (3 plans + testIDs), and You tab all render correctly on 390x844 mobile viewport. Login → today greeting and full AI insight worked with the seeded test account.

minor.issue: Supabase currently accepts junk domains (e.g. @x.test) with 200 — note in test_credentials.md said these would be rejected. Not blocking, but confirm Supabase project settings if strict domain validation is desired.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping Continue when paywall was opened via deep link shows console error: 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator.' Entitlement sync likely still succeeds server-side but the user is left on the paywall screen. Should router.replace('/(tabs)/today') (or router.canGoBack() check) instead of router.back() when no history exists.

On Expo web preview, after successfully sending an Ask message from the Ask tab, the URL sometimes changes to /you and the streamed reply is not shown in the Ask conversation (the AI reply text appears on Today insight instead). Likely web-only Expo Router group-tab quirk with streamChat re-render; verify on native. AI reply itself is generated (backend /message returns 200 and text).

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' in React Native Web (0.75+). Non-blocking but should migrate to keep future compatibility.

action_items: Fix paywall Continue when opened via deep link: use router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)/today') after entitlement sync succeeds.

Investigate Ask tab on web: after streamChat completes, the streamed assistant message should be visible in the Ask conversation list; currently the tab appears to unmount / URL shifts to /you on web preview. Test on Expo Go or a native build to confirm whether this is web-only.
Optional: migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' to remove React Native Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~860 lines and mixes many domains (auth/chart/ask/vastu/entitlement/admin). Consider splitting into routers per domain (auth_router, chart_router, ask_router, etc.) for maintainability.

server.py /vastu/analyze reads r['x']+r['width']; no server-side pydantic validation of the rooms schema. If a caller sends {'w','h'} instead of {'width','height'} the endpoint 500s. Add a Room pydantic model with strict fields.
server.py uses on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); FastAPI recommends the lifespan context manager (deprecation warnings likely on newer FastAPI).

Free-tier gating counts total user messages ever ('select count(*) from messages where role=user'); soft-deleted conversations still count. If a user deletes a convo, their free counter is not reset — probably intentional but confirm product intent.

rca_of_issue: Paywall Continue error RCA: paywall.tsx likely calls router.back() unconditionally after successful entitlement sync; when navigation history is empty (user opened paywall via deep link / 402 from Ask that trimmed history) React Navigation emits 'GO_BACK not handled'. Fix: replace with `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)/today')`.
